title: Speed and kinematic identification — 6-blade fan at 412.9 rpm
summary: Fan (6 blades, Muse Spark model) speed MAP 412.9 rpm = 6.882 Hz, 68% CI 412.3–413.6 rpm, p_map=0.972 vs ½× alternative 206.4 rpm p=0.028; 15/18 peaks explained. No display_rpm available (null), so no independent display cross-check. Derived blade-pass = 6 × 6.882 = 41.3 Hz (audio-sourced). Video Nyquist is 15.0 Hz (30 fps) with near-Nyquist warning, so video orders above that cannot corroborate BPF.

title: Resonance — 11.35 Hz structural mode crossed on run-up
summary: Structural mode 11.347 ±0.059 Hz, ζ=0.0211 ±0.0039 (Q≈23.7, +12.3 dB evidence), fault posterior P(resonance)=0.700. Campbell criticals: 1× at 680.8 rpm and 2× at 340.4 rpm. Current 412.9 rpm is between them — 2× (13.76 Hz) is above the mode and 1× (6.88 Hz) below it — but the observed start-from-standstill run-up necessarily crossed the 2× critical at 340.4 rpm. Caveat: 11.35 Hz is at 76% of the 15.0 Hz video Nyquist and near-Nyquist warning is set, so confirm this mode with a higher-fps (e.g. ≥60 fps) or accelerometer capture before treating its frequency/damping as final.

title: Blade-pass / flow excitation — inconclusive, not a proven off-design fault
summary: P(flow)=0.439 but with wide p_range 0.030–0.451; evidence is BPF/1× (audio) value 103.0, +8.7 dB. Audio is dominant smooth broadband aerodynamic airflow from the 6-blade fan with blade-pass wavering and no rubbing/impacts — blade-pass presence alone does not prove off-design flow. Evidence is weak/wide-ranging; do not conclude a flow fault without duty/flow measurement corroboration.

title: Looseness rejected; cavitation not supported
summary: Looseness P=0.0043: only 1 shaft harmonic 1–10× above 10 dB (−8.7 dB) and half-order lines 0.7 dB (−4.3 dB) — against looseness (not the many-harmonics pattern). Cavitation index 0.00187, HF energy fraction 0.000468, HF kurtosis −0.015, and audio reports no cavitation-like crackle; this is a fan, not a pump. Note fault-posterior cavitation is evaluable:false, so this is 'not supported on available indices/audio', not a formal exclusion.

title: Uncalibrated amplitude — no ISO 20816 zone; several faults not evaluable
summary: scale_calibrated=false: the s1 fan-shroud 4.796 mm/s RMS is relative/uncalibrated only, so I do NOT assign any ISO 20816 zone or absolute mm/s severity — conclusions rest on frequencies, orders and ratios. Imbalance (P=0.15=prior), misalignment (0.10), bearing (0.08), rotor-bar (0.05), combustion (0.10) and cavitation (0.08) are evaluable:false. Ordered velocities at current speed are effectively nil (1× 4.5e-18, 2× 5.3e-18 mm/s), so no 1×-dominant/phase evidence exists. Needed: a calibrated capture with radial 1×/2× amplitude+phase (two channels across any coupling for misalignment phase), higher-fps sampling for modes near Nyquist, and envelope/HF data for bearing assessment.

# WO-261104-F03A5 · Factory exhaust fan

**Priority:** P2 (within 7 days)  
**Failure mode:** VIB – Vibration (ISO 14224)  
**Suspected cause:** Forcing frequency coincident with a structural natural frequency (posterior 0.7)  
**Raised by:** muse-wonder-1.0 · 2026-11-04 17:11

Fan at 412.9 rpm crossed the 2× critical at 340.4 rpm on run-up; structural mode is 11.347±0.059 Hz, ζ=0.021. Inspect fan-shroud mounts, guards and support stiffness/damping for looseness, cracks or soft mounting, and stiffen/damp as found. Re-capture at ≥60 fps or with a calibrated accelerometer (mode is near the 15 Hz video Nyquist and amplitudes are uncalibrated) before/after any modification.

## Evidence
- critical speed inside the swept range (Q) = 23.7 (+12.3 dB)
- Amplitudes uncalibrated: severity from frequencies and ratios
- Running speed 413 rpm (audio (blade pass) · kinematic posterior (×0.501))

## Safety
- Lock out / tag out (LOTO) the drive and isolate process energy
- Guards back on before restart; no loose clothing near rotating parts

## Tasks
1. Program VFD skip frequencies over the resonance bands (Argonaut can do this).
2. If the duty needs that speed: detune the structure. To move fn above the forcing by 15 %, stiffness must rise by the factor computed below (mass unchanged).
3. Re-run a coast-down; confirm the Campbell crossing has moved out of the operating range.

## Parts
- Bracing / stiffener per detuning calculation

**Estimated time:** 1.0 h

## Verification
Re-measure with Argonaut after the work; acceptance: fault posterior < 0.2 and ISO zone A/B (or unchanged frequencies/ratios if uncalibrated).

text:
## Assessment — Factory exhaust fan (6-blade axial fan)

**Identification**
- Running speed: **412.9 rpm (6.882 Hz)**, 68% CI 412.3–413.6 rpm. Speed posterior is unambiguous: p_map = **0.972** (½× alternative 206.4 rpm, p = 0.028), 15/18 peaks explained — no kinematic what-if test needed. No display_rpm readback available (null), so no independent display cross-check. Calculated blade-pass = 6 × 6.882 = **41.3 Hz** (audio-sourced; above the 15.0 Hz video Nyquist).
- **Amplitudes are uncalibrated** (scale_calibrated = false): I report **no ISO 20816 zone and no absolute mm/s severity**; all conclusions rest on frequencies, orders and ratios only.

**Diagnosis**
- ⚠️ **Resonance — leading fault, P = 0.700.** Structural mode **11.347 ± 0.059 Hz, ζ = 0.0211 ± 0.0039** (Q ≈ 23.7, +12.3 dB). Campbell criticals: **2× at 340.4 rpm** and **1× at 680.8 rpm**. Current 412.9 rpm sits between them, but the recorded start-from-standstill run-up necessarily crossed the 340.4 rpm 2× critical. Caveat: 11.35 Hz is ~76% of the 15 Hz video Nyquist and a near-Nyquist warning is flagged — confirm with a ≥60 fps or accelerometer capture before finalising mode frequency/damping.
- **Blade-pass/flow excitation inconclusive:** P(flow) = 0.439 but with a wide range (0.030–0.451); audio shows smooth broadband aerodynamic noise with no rubbing/impacts. Not proven off-design — needs a flow/duty measurement to corroborate.
- **Looseness rejected:** P = 0.004 (only 1 harmonic 1–10× above 10 dB; half-orders 0.7 dB). **Cavitation not supported:** index 0.0019, HF fraction 0.00047, no cavitation-like audio (and this is a fan, not a pump).
- **Not evaluable on this capture:** imbalance, misalignment, bearing, rotor-bar (posteriors = priors only; ordered 1×/2× velocities effectively nil, no phase data). Needed: calibrated radial 1×/2× amplitude + phase (two channels across a coupling for misalignment), higher-rate sampling, envelope/HF data for bearings. Accordingly, **no balancing action is proposed** (imbalance P < 0.5 threshold and not evaluable).

## Optimisation proposal p92448 — awaiting your approval

- **412.9 → 374.5 rpm** (feasible band 374.5–412.9 rpm)
- Duty: **91% of current flow** (minimum required 80%) ✔
- Resonance: sits at the **10% minimum separation above the 340.4 rpm 2× critical**; exclusion bands 306.4–374.5 rpm and 612.7–748.9 rpm. It is at the band edge — do not set below 374.5 rpm. NPSH not applicable (fan, no liquid duty).
- Energy: **0.100 → 0.0746 kW (−25.4%)**. Trade-off: twin predicts **+25.7% relative vibration** (uncalibrated scale — no ISO implication). If re-measurement shows worse vibration, prefer the upper part of the feasible band.
- Annualised impact (tool assumptions: 6,000 h/yr, $0.12/kWh, 0.45 kg CO₂/kWh): **152.5 kWh/yr, $18.31/yr, 0.069 t CO₂/yr saved**.

## Actions queued

1. **Work order WO-261104-F03A5** (P2, 7 days) — resonance: inspect/stiffen/damp shroud mounts and supports; re-capture at ≥60 fps or with calibrated accelerometer.
2. **Skip frequencies** over both exclusion bands — *not applied: no drive connected*, so the procedure is Task 1 of the work order instead.
3. **Follow-up re-measurement due 2026-12-04** (30 days): verify the Campbell crossing is skipped/moved, fault posterior < 0.2, dwell ≥374.5 rpm holds duty, and gather the calibrated phase data to make imbalance/misalignment/bearing evaluable.
